subject: Saltonstall Modernization Construction and Permanent Lending
overview: The board approved financing for the Saltonstall modernization project and certified several state-mandated financial and compliance reports. The Authority selected Citizens Bank and the Massachusetts Housing Partnership as the primary lenders for the project's construction and permanent debt.

items.title: Saltonstall Modernization Construction and Permanent Lenders
items.summary: Approved the selection of Citizens Bank as lead construction lender and the Massachusetts Housing Partnership as permanent lender for the Saltonstall modernization. Natalie explained that the selected team offered the most favorable economic terms for a $68 million tax-exempt bond and a $25 million taxable loan.

items.title: Year-End Financial Statement Certifications
items.summary: Approved the certification of year-end financial statements for the 400-1, 689, and MRVP programs. Michael reported that the programs are operating with surpluses, including a 91% reserve ratio for Wachlan Court.

items.title: Top 5 Compensation and Lead Paint Compliance
items.summary: Approved the Top 5 Compensation Form and the Certificate of Compliance with federal and state lead paint laws as required by the Department of Housing and Community Development.
